Project01.paragraph: Built an AI-powered form responder using Microsoft Forms, Azure Logic Apps, Outlook, and Azure OpenAI. The workflow captures form submissions, uses Azure OpenAI to generate intelligent responses, and sends automated replies through Outlook. The deployed cloud resources were disabled/deleted after testing to control Azure costs, while architecture documentation and screenshots are preserved for demonstration.
features1: Microsoft Forms trigger captures new form submissions automatically
Azure Logic Apps retrieves the submitted response details
Azure OpenAI generates a customized AI response
Microsoft Outlook sends the generated response by email
End-to-end workflow reduces manual follow-up and saves time

Project02.paragraph: The Email Reminder Agent takes an email, reminder message and the date/time you want to send your reminder. Then verifies the user's email via a 6 digit email verification process. After this, the agent schedules your reminder to be sent to your email at the requested date/time.
features1: Schedule reminders to yourself in the future
Azure Container Apps for hosting frontend userface and AI Agent logic
Azure AI Foundry for hosting deployed LLM
Azure Cosmos DB for storing verification data and scheduled reminders
Azure Functions for forwarding scheduled reminder via Timer trigger to Azure Logic App
Azure Logic Apps to send verification emails and scheduled reminder emails sent from Azure Function
Azure Container Apps for hosting container images for Azure Container Apps
